title: Den2Obj
description: A command-line tool for generating isosurfaces from electron-density scalar fields. Den2Obj reads VASP CHGCAR, PARCHG, and LOCPOT files as well as Gaussian Cube files, and exports meshes in OBJ, PLY, and STL formats. It also supports conversion to the lossless compressed D2O format and, when enabled, OpenVDB.
